description: Move the pointer across the smoked crosswind chamber to inspect the fall through its broad light; the light stays where you leave it. Inspect the lettered inlet mouths to reveal their concealed connections to the numbered gates. Learned routes remain visible and let you anticipate the catcher position. Release the automatic stream. Steer the matching pocket around each falling marble, then press Enter or Latch Pockets while the whole marble is inside its outlined chamber. Steering takes time. Swap pocket assignments with Space or the visible button. Each marble follows and flips its gates, and changing crosswinds bend its fall. An empty or misaligned latch, or a marble escaping through the floor, ends this episode. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in this task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload or navigation, browser extensions, external applications, implementation or hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs.
